deadline.quote: The application deadline for Autumn 2027 entry to the graduate program is December 17, 2026.

gre_general.value: The department no longer accepts GRE scores; do not include them.
gre_general.quote: The Department no longer accepts GRE scores. Please do not include GRE scores anywhere in your application materials.

gre_subject.value: Subject GRE scores are not accepted either.
gre_subject.quote: The Department of the Geophysical Sciences no longer accepts General GRE or subject GRE scores for applications for graduate admission.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum required TOEFL score is a 90 overall.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum required IELTS score is a 7 overall.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly advised to reach out to a prospective advisor before applying, though the application does not require naming one.
supervisor.quote: It is strongly recommended that applicants reach out to a prospective advisor before applying.

funding.value: Physical Sciences Division PhD admits are offered funding packages covering full tuition, health insurance and a stipend.
funding.quote: Applicants admitted to doctoral programs in the Physical Sciences Division are offered generous funding packages. | Offers include full tuition, student health insurance and student services fee coverage, and primary funding
